_about: Default Three Pillars gate config. Copy this, fill in the product bits (name, source, test_files, test_cmd, criteria), and sign it when you are satisfied. The common checks are already set; add to them. Build or edit it visually with ui/index.html.
name: your-product

human._criteria_help: Exact rules the code must follow. rule: 'forbid' (pattern must not appear), 'require' (pattern must appear), 'min_tests' (at least count test functions). Add your own.

criteria.reason: cover the edges, not just the happy path

engine._note: Used only for Java, JavaScript and CSS (TestThisPuppy). Python ignores this and uses the native checks.
